product_family: News API (aggregated multi-lingual news/content from 80,000+ sources) and Text Analysis / Text API (NLP entity extraction, sentiment, classification); Aylien was acquired by Quantexa (London) in February 2023 and its News API is now also marketed as Quantexa's 'News Intelligence' solution, while aylien.com continues to operate as a distinct product brand/site.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 1
certifications.proof_quote: Parent company Quantexa's trust center lists 'SOC 2 Report - Decision Intelligence Platform' and 'SOC 2 Report - Quantexa Unify' as the two audited scopes; no entry for Aylien, News API, or Text Analysis appears anywhere on the page. Cannot confirm this product line is covered by Quantexa's SOC 2 report.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Quantexa's trust center lists only Type 1 reports for 2025/2026 ('SOC 2 Report - Decision Intelligence Platform', 'SOC 2 Report - Quantexa Unify'); no Type 2 report is listed for any product.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
certifications.proof_quote: Parent company Quantexa lists 'ISO/IEC 27001:2022' and an 'ISO/IEC 27001 SoA' (Statement of Applicability) as current on its trust center, but the page makes no mention of Aylien, News API, or Text Analysis, so the certified scope/legal entity coverage for this product line is unconfirmed.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27017:2015 (cloud security controls)
certifications.proof_quote: Listed as current on Quantexa's trust center ('ISO/IEC 27017:2015'), same scope caveat as ISO 27001 above: no reference to Aylien/News API/Text Analysis on the page.

certifications.name: GDPR (regulatory posture)
certifications.proof_quote: Aylien's own privacy policy states users can exercise rights to have personal data erased, object to processing, request data in a portable format, request restriction of processing, and withdraw consent, and directs GDPR-related requests to the Data Protection Officer at dpo@aylien.com, Aylien HQ, 46 Mount Street Upper, Dublin 2, Ireland.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Aylien's privacy policy and Quantexa's trust center make no mention of HIPAA or a Business Associate Agreement; the product is a news/text-analytics API, not marketed for handling PHI.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI management systems)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Quantexa's trust center certification list (Cyber Essentials Plus, GDPR, IRAP, ISO 22301, ISO 27001, ISO 27017, JOSCAR, NIST 800-53 Rev.5, SOC 2 Type 1, EcoVadis, NHS DSPT) does not include ISO 42001.

certifications.name: CSA STAR / CSA STAR for AI
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Not listed among Quantexa's trust center certifications, and no independent source confirms a CSA STAR registry entry for Quantexa or Aylien.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found on Aylien's or Quantexa's own domains.

privacy.ai_training_note: Aylien's News API Terms of Service grant customers a limited internal-use license to the data and restrict customers from sublicensing, selling, or redistributing it, but do not state whether Aylien/Quantexa uses customer-submitted content or usage data to train models. A third-party integration marketplace (Relevance AI, not Aylien's or Quantexa's own domain) claims customer data is 'never utilized for model training,' but this could not be verified on a vendor-owned page, so training posture is recorded as unconfirmed rather than assumed.
privacy.data_region: Not publicly specified. Aylien's registered address is Dublin, Ireland (per its privacy policy); no explicit data-residency guarantee is published for the News API/Text Analysis product line.

security.name: Encryption / security measures (product-level)
security.value: Aylien's own privacy policy uses only general language ('we use appropriate security measures to seek to prevent unauthorised access or disclosure'; 'a variety of security technologies and procedures'), with no specifics on encryption in transit/at rest, and no product-level security whitepaper found.

security.name: Corporate-level certifications (parent company Quantexa)
security.value: Quantexa (parent) maintains a SafeBase-hosted trust center listing ISO/IEC 27001:2022, ISO/IEC 27017:2015, ISO 22301, Cyber Essentials Plus, SOC 2 Type 1 (Decision Intelligence Platform; Quantexa Unify), NIST 800-53 Rev.5, IRAP, JOSCAR, GDPR, EcoVadis, and NHS DSPT -- but none of these entries name Aylien, News API, or Text Analysis as being in scope.

security.name: Data protection contact
security.value: Dedicated Data Protection Officer contact for privacy/GDPR requests: dpo@aylien.com.

products.name: News API
products.data_scope: Aggregated multi-lingual news and content metadata/text from 80,000+ public sources; customer usage statistics shared back with Aylien per ToS
products.notes: Original flagship Aylien product; also marketed post-acquisition as part of Quantexa's 'News Intelligence' solution for financial crime/KYC use cases.

products.name: Text API / Text Analysis API
products.category: NLP API (entity extraction, sentiment, classification, summarization)
products.data_scope: Customer-submitted text processed via API calls
products.notes: Separate Terms of Service from News API (https://aylien.com/legal/text-api-terms-of-service); no distinct security documentation found.

products.name: Decision Intelligence Platform (parent, Quantexa)
products.category: Enterprise decision intelligence / entity resolution platform
products.data_scope: Enterprise customer data (banking, insurance, public sector)
products.notes: This is the Quantexa flagship product explicitly named in Quantexa's SOC 2 and ISO 27001 scope; it is a different product from the Aylien News API/Text Analysis line and its certifications should not be attributed to Aylien without confirmation.

compare.pricing_model: API subscription/usage tiers with a free/trial tier (trial and free-subscriber accounts must display an Aylien logo per ToS); exact enterprise pricing not publicly listed
compare.data_residency: Not publicly specified for the API product line

flags: Identity/scope ambiguity: Aylien (Dublin, founded 2012) was acquired by Quantexa (London) in February 2023. The only vendor-domain trust center found (trust.quantexa.com) is Quantexa's corporate trust center, and it lists real ISO 27001, ISO 27017, and SOC 2 Type 1 certifications -- but scopes them explicitly to 'Decision Intelligence Platform' and 'Quantexa Unify', with no mention anywhere of Aylien, News API, or Text Analysis. Do not display Quantexa's corporate badges against the Aylien News API/Text Analysis listing without a vendor confirmation that those audits cover this product.

aylien.com and docs.aylien.com could not be directly fetched from this environment (DNS resolution failed on repeated attempts); findings for aylien.com-specific pages rely on indexed search-result snippets rather than a direct page fetch, which is a minor evidence-quality gap despite being genuine vendor-domain content.
AI-training posture is unconfirmed on any vendor-owned page; a third-party site's 'never used for training' claim should not be repeated as fact without vendor confirmation.
No public DPA (Data Processing Agreement) document was found linked from Aylien's own site; enterprise customers likely need to request one directly.
